description: This file defines the TagMutator class, responsible for mutating Tag-related data in a synchronized data model within a TypeScript project. It provides methods to modify tag properties, manage parent-child relationships, and handle associated file and note references.

classes.name: TagMutator
classes.description: A class that provides mutation capabilities for Tag objects, including setting properties, managing hierarchy and references, and handling associated notes and files.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new TagMutator instance with the given item and mutation type.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Setter for the tag's title property.

methods.name: expanded
methods.description: Setter for the expanded state of the tag.

methods.name: iconString
methods.description: Setter for the icon string associated with the tag.

methods.name: preferences
methods.description: Getter for the tag's preferences; initializes preferences if not already set.

methods.name: makeChildOf
methods.description: Sets the current tag as a child of the specified parent tag.

methods.name: unsetParent
methods.description: Removes any parent associations from the tag.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Associates a file with the tag.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes an associated file from the tag.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Associates a note with the tag.

methods.name: removeNote
methods.description: Removes an associated note from the tag.

ctags.name: TagMutator
ctags.pattern: /^export class TagMutator<Content extends TagContent = TagContent> extends DecryptedItemMutator<Co/
